notes.title: Small Update - 7/5/2024
notes.content: Redesigned Hoofobia gameplay with client-side prediction to improve any lag felt on clients

notes.title: Small Patch - 7/2/2024
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[b]Deer:[/b]
[list][*] Deer now accelerate and decelerate more gradually when going from sprinting to stopping
[*] Added new fall animation for deer 
[*] Added more realistic turning animation for deer 
[*] Re-updated stamina bar without lag issue [/list]
[b]Hunter:[/b]
[list][*] Fixed issue where hunter would hover around the map while reloading 
[*] Fixed issue where hunters gun would awkwardly snap away from his hand when reloading[/list]
[b]Imposter Hunt:[/b]
[list][*] Lowered volume level of Imposter Deer sprinting | Made the proximity bubble of sound less intense, however hunters can still hear Imposter deer run from across the map[/list]
[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[b]Imposter Hunt:[/b]
[list][*] Stopped glitch where hunter knock down music would still play even after he is fully insane
[*] Stopped glitch where hunter would still glow red with invincibility even when he is fully insane 
[/list]

notes.title: Small Patch - 7/1/2024
notes.content:
[h2][h1]Bugs[/h1][/h2]
[list]
[*] Redesigned Fawnlawn Park Night level so that assets aren't clipping through the ground
[*] Fixed issue with the mic symbol above deer heads always showing as active when a player joins mid match [/list]
[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list][*] Lowered deer sprint speed on Hit and Run & Stay Close
[*] Added stamina bar for deer on Hit and Run & Stay Close 
[*] Added "Imposter Hunt" to the list of "Popular Game Modes" for new Hoofobia players
[/list]

notes.title: Small Patch - 6/27/2024
notes.content:
[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[list][*] Improved issue where joining a session from session browser or starting matchmaking would create an infinite loading screen 
[*] Redesigned Session browser to show more up-to-date lobbies 
[*] Fixed issue with the lobby not displaying the map name
[*] Fixed issue where the session browser list wasn't displaying the map name 
[*] Fixed bug where deer would occasionally disappear after getting skinned
[*] Fixed issue where gameplay widgets and messages would still display after the game was over (Affecting all game modes) 
[*] Removed ability to score after the game has already ended (All Game modes)
[*] Stopped the 'Game over' sound effect from playing multiple times (All Game Modes) [/list]

notes.title: Small Patch - 6/26/2024
notes.content:
[h2]Updates [/h2]
[list][*] Reduced game file size by 700mb [/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[b]Brightness and flashlights:[/b]
[list][*] Made Old Circus night brighter 
[*] Made Tiny Garden night brighter 
[*] Made Hunter flashlight brighter on Hit And Run & Stay Close
[*] Fixed issue with other players not seing the flashlight over the server 
[*] Added Hunter ability to use flash light on all game modes
[*] Renamed Hunter Rage to Hunter Invincibility[/list]
[h2]Bugs [/h2]
[b]General:[/b]
[list][*] Fixed Single Player Explore not working | Added working loading screens 
[*] Removed glitch where Hunter can use his scope after the game has ended
[*] Fixed bug where to in-game (TAB) player list would occasionally stop working 
[*] Fixed bug with the Hunters score occasionally disappearing on Hit And Run 
[*] Removed cross hairs that popup at the end of the match [/list]

notes.title: Small Patch (2) - 4/6/2024
notes.content:
[u]Imposter Hunt Patches: [/u]
[list][*] Fixed issue with match not ending when insanity is fully reached
[*] Improved issue with insanity going over 100 
[*] Reverted back to previous update so shooting AI deer only increases insanity by 20 points instead of 30[/list]

notes.title: Medium Update - 4/6/2024
notes.content:
[h2][b]Updates[/b][/h2]
[u]Level Design:[/u]
[list][*] Redid all bushes on Mini Meadows | made the edge of map boundary more clear with large bushes [/list]
[u]Character Design: [/u]
[list][*] Now requiring the deer to hold attack in order to knock over the hunter in order to give consistency to all game modes
[*] Added the hunter glowing red when he is in the ragdoll invincibility cool-down to make this more clear
[*] Added an exclamation with a progress bar above the hunters head when he's in the ragdoll invincibility cool-down to make this more clear[/list]
[u]Misc.:[/u]
[list][*] Rolled back the previous update that stopped the hunter from getting sanity points back when he killed deer in Stay Close. The hunter will now regain sanity from getting any deer kills in order to balance this game mode again[/list]
[h2][b]Patches[/b][/h2]
[u]Level Design:[/u]
[list][*] Fixed issue with camera spawning under the map on Tiny Garden Imposter Hunt
[*] Fixed non-loading textures on circus tent [/list]
[u]Character design:[/u]
[list][*] Enabled hunter flashlight on all maps | fixed issue with only the hunter seeing the flashlight and not the deer 
[*] Improved issue with AI deer occasionally hovering around without a working animation
[*] Fixed issue with the "H" direction icon at the top of the screen not working when deer join mid match in Hit and Run 
[*] Added Safety measures so if the hunter falls under the map in all Imposter Hunt maps he is teleported back to the surface 
[*] Fixed glitch where crouching as deer would eventually cause all the deer footsteps to sound quiet even when walking normally 
[*] Improved issues with the deer revival being finicky to use in imposter hunt 
[*] Removed erroneous Imposter Hunt message on screen that two downed deer they can revive each other 
[*] Fixed issue with the camera being too low after deer revival on imposter hunt[/list]

notes.content: Patched an error with the deer not spawning in Imposter Hunt due to an issue with todays update.

notes.content:

[b]Patches: [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where you could walk out of the map and into the void on all Forgotten Tracks levels. 
[*] Improved issue where deer die standing up in Hit And Run
[/list]

notes.content:

notes.title: Small Patch | Unlimited FPS - 3/14/2024
notes.content:
[h2][b]Updates[/b][/h2]
Added support for uncapped FPS and added menu entries for toggling your desired frame rate.

[h2][b]Patches [/b][/h2]
Fixed issue with the "H" compass icon not working for pointing deer players towards the hunters location.

notes.title: Small Patch - 3/8/2024
notes.content: Fixed Hit and Run mouse input occasionally not working when playing as deer.

notes.title: Small Patches - 3/8/2024
notes.content:
[h2][b]Patches [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Made the Hunter insanity level go up twice as fast in Stay Close and fixed some desynch issues.
[*] Added more cover for the deer's on Stay Close levels that had no cover and enabled the hunter to camp at. 
[/list]

[h2][b]Updates[/b][/h2]
[i]The following updates are to improve the playability and understandability of Imposter Hunt:[/i]
[list]
[*] Made Imposter Hunt reviving 2x quicker.
[*] Removed the hunters ability to see the "Waiting for Revival" Icon above knocked deers in Imposter Hunt. 
[*] Made Imposter Hunt deer unable to click the attack button when the Hunter sanity countdown is playing.
[*] Added a message hint "Blend in with the herd" when the hunters insanity is counting down in Imposter Hunt.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Patches - 3/5/2024
notes.content:
[h2][b]Patches[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with the sound settings sliders not having any effect 
[*] Mastered all music tracks to be lower volume by default to match the gameplay 
[*] Fixed issue with the pause menu getting stuck on the screen occasionally
[*] Patched issue with the hunter sometimes not spawning on Hoof High
[/list]

notes.title: Major Updates | Stay Close and Hit & Run- 3/2/2024
notes.content:
[h2][b]Updates[/b][/h2]
[u]Stay Close & Hit and Run - Fairness and balancing:[/u]
[list]
[*] Added more bushes to all maps in Stay Close/Hit And Run to ensure the hunter can't cheat by finding a wide open area to camp at.
[*] Added water reeds and tall bushes to lakes in Stay Close/Hit And Run to ensure deer always have cover to hide. 
[*] Removed the old and slow deer attack which slows down the deer and replaced it with a sprinting ram attack.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZmpuNWNzdXdneXc4djlpcG45NWt2M2d2NTF6MDNuZGlhbDZjb2w2bCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/WESmNdnI7MGhQBMd7h/giphy.gif[/img]
[*] Added a visual status bar above the hunters head in hit and run that indicates when the hunter is invincible and impervious to ragdolling. This will help deer plan their attacks better and not be confused on why the hunter isn't ragdolling when attacked:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYTJ3eWx3Z3lseW9lbnYyejF1cjJ6bm5pczI5eG8zbDFtOXN6a3NwbSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/RVJqfeqBqsc5EVKUai/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]
[*] Made hunter faster when in rage after being attacked by a deer.
[/list]

[h2][b]Patches[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the exposure auto adjusting for players when inside the forcefield which caused game to be far too dark. 
[*] Designed a system that teleports the hunter back up to the map if he falls under. 
[*] Fixed small glitch where the camera spawns under the map at the start of matches.
[/list]

notes.title: Imposter Hunter Revamp 2/3 | Update 1.3.2 - 2/29/2024
notes.content:
[b]Updates: [/b]
In Imposter hunt, deer can now revive their paralyzed friends!
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMTUwZWk3MnluNDB6eTl4NzI1MzU4YTc3Z3g2Nmw3dHB3ajExcmoyZSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/ulv04J9qvNyHAiwhIw/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

notes.title: Imposter Hunt Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] The buggy spectator mode has been removed entirely and replaced with free roaming as a partially paralyzed deer. Reviving paralyzed deer will likely be coming in tomorrow's update. 
[/list]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYmptODZzYXUwbGVwZTl1MjRvMGtjbmt4N2loNXNpMXhnN3Vtb3kzNSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/N7metEJI4PJQNB4e6x/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[b]Major bug patches: [/b]
[list]
[*] There is no longer a delay between hunter insanity maxing out and the deer team winning the match. All deer will now instantly stand up when hunter insanity is maxed out. 
[*] Players that join the game mid match can now see the hunter insanity score.
[/list]

[b]Small Bug Patches: [/b]
[u]Level design: [/u]
[list]
[*] patched not being able to fit through tennis court doorways.
[*] patched hunters ability to get on top of the circus tent.
[/list]
[u]Character: [/u]
[list]
[*] Made AI deer and player deer walk speed faster to give the deer team an added advantage.
[*] Deer can no longer make running noises when killed.
[*] Lowered the volume of the Imposter Hunt Insanity countdown track. 
[*] Deer feet no longer get stuck in the air after running, which gives his identity away to the hunter. 
[*] Lowered the volume of gun sounds.
[*] Deer can no longer lay down and run silently towards the hunter.
[*] Deer can no longer crouch and sprint silently towards the hunter. 
[*] Hunter scope no longer gets stuck on the screen when he gets rammed and ragdolls.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.3.1 Update | Imposter Hunt Revamp 1/3 - 2/26/2024
notes.content:
[b]UPDATES: [/b]
[list]
[*] Added a more satisfying deer attack animation. Hunter will now also ragdoll when attacked.
[*] Added a more dynamic hunter voice acting system
[*] Increased hunter sprint speed to equal deer speed when the insanity countdown is playing. This is to avoid deer playing cat and mouse around buildings and obstacles.
[/list]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExejEzMDEwZWZwdmdjb2d2OTlmcWR3ZGU0aG11aXpkbHpxcGdoazM0OSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/eNVyohirqUu5FaPmlh/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]PATCHES:[/b]
-Patched mid match joining within the first 20 seconds of a match start causing all players to spawn as deer 
-Made Hunter Insanity Meter more reliable, although issues may still be occurring in high ping matches

notes.title: Version 1.2 Update - 2/25/2024
notes.content:
UPDATES:
-Added a "Create Match" main menu option for creating private matches with parties
-Added a map selection picker under Create Match that's compatible with public matchmaking
-Added a feature so the same map never plays twice in a row

PATCHES: 
-Patched a glitch where mid match joining causes a hunter to randomly spawn 
-Fixed bug in Imposter Hunt where AI deer are registered as player deer causing no increase in hunter rage. The Issue with the "Hunter Insanity" meter replication problem is still being tested and can be expected in tomorrows update.
